item.title: Glaukion #8043 the Twice-Born of the House of Echion fell (fell in the war of Burning Lake
item.description: Glaukion #8043 the Twice-Born of the House of Echion fell (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Dilaos #1567 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The Gegeneis made room at
item.description: Dilaos #1567 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The Gegeneis made room at the fire, but no one sat close.

item.description: Glauchlaos Peisonides ~1308 was born in Bear Mountain to Peison #2788 and Alkkrates #3905, the first Leaf of their line.

item.title: Dilaos #1567 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus).
item.description: Dilaos #1567 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
